title: "svelte/no-dupe-else-if-blocks"

A branch of an `{#if}` chain whose condition repeats an earlier one, or is covered by it, never renders. `a || b` and `b || a` count as the same, and so do `a && b` and `b && a`.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-dupe-else-if-blocks": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
{#if user.isAdmin}
  <AdminPanel />
{:else if user.isAdmin}
  <Settings />
{/if}
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
{#if user.isAdmin}
  <AdminPanel />
{:else if user.isEditor}
  <Settings />
{/if}
```
